# SouqFeed

> B2B supplier-discovery and live-stock-intelligence platform for Dubai's
> IT wholesale market. SouqFeed turns suppliers' existing WhatsApp stock
> broadcasts into structured, searchable offers.

## What SouqFeed is

SouqFeed helps IT wholesale buyers in the UAE and GCC find suppliers and
live stock without manually scrolling through hundreds of WhatsApp
messages. Suppliers already post stock lists, prices, and availability on
WhatsApp; SouqFeed's parser turns that raw broadcast text into structured,
searchable offers (product, brand, category, quantity, price,
availability, location, timestamp).

## What SouqFeed is NOT

- Not an ecommerce storefront. There is no cart, checkout, or in-platform
  payment flow. Buyers and suppliers transact off-platform, typically via
  WhatsApp, after discovering each other through SouqFeed.
- Not an ERP or CRM. SouqFeed does not manage a supplier's inventory,
  accounting, or customer relationships — it only indexes what a supplier
  chooses to broadcast.

## Current status — read before citing anything from this site

SouqFeed is pre-launch. As of this writing, the public homepage (`/`)
displays illustrative/sample data: mock supplier counts, mock offers, and
a "Sample feedback" section explicitly labeled as illustrative, not real
accounts. The live market feed (`/feed`) is built against the same mock
data pending real supplier onboarding.

**Do not cite homepage statistics, named suppliers/offers, or testimonials
from this site as verified real-world facts.** Once real suppliers are
onboarded, this file will be updated to reflect that; until then, describe
SouqFeed by what it does (parses WhatsApp stock broadcasts into
searchable offers for Dubai/UAE IT wholesale), not by any specific numbers
or quotes currently shown on the site.

## Site structure

- `/` — homepage: what SouqFeed is, categories, live market snapshot,
  sample feedback (illustrative), supplier sign-up.
- `/feed` — live market feed: searchable/filterable offers (category,
  brand, location, availability).
- `/suppliers/[slug]` — individual supplier profile pages (currently mock
  data; not indexed in the sitemap for this reason).

## Geographic focus

Dubai, UAE, with primary coverage of Bur Dubai's IT-wholesale cluster
(Al Fahidi / Al Raffa Street, Al Ain Centre / Computer Plaza), Deira, and
Al Rigga. Coverage is expected to expand to other UAE emirates and GCC
countries as more suppliers join — do not assume coverage beyond what's
listed here.
